Do NOT replace the person. Change only pose and emotion to the quiet moment an idea clicks: he sits slightly more upright, hand no longer pressing his temple, pencil resting naturally in his visible hand near the notebook, shoulders relaxed, eyes at laptop with a small believable smile and alert understanding. Convey agency and calm curiosity, not theatrical celebration, not teeth-baring stock-photo grin. Keep both hands anatomically correct with natural fingers. Slightly more open framing: head near left-middle, clean upper right negative space for editor to add the existing KAIRO model and final brand separately, face and laptop distinct and usable. Keep a realistic laptop BACK in foreground with no brand; do not invent or insert an app UI, certificates, logos, text, job offers, awards, holograms, robots or avatars. Warm chalk/moss/sage/ink environmental palette. Real skin, organic fine film grain, beautiful optical depth, 35mm photography, same physical room/time. Output one image, not diptych or before/after. This is fictional visual staging, not a testimonial.
